PCA Equations

Source: R/pca_plots.R
pca_eqns.Rd

Writes out each principal component as a linear equation in the original features (abbreviated f1, f2, ... — see the returned labels table for what each abbreviation means).

Usage

pca_eqns(PC_mod, precision = 3)

Arguments

PC_mod

A prcomp object.

precision

Digits to round loadings to (default 3).

Value

A list with two tibbles: eqns (one row per component, with its equation as text) and labels (feature-number-to-name key).

Examples

pca_model <- prcomp(mtcars, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_eqns(pca_model)$eqns

#>    PC       rhs                                                                 
#>    <chr>    <chr>
